title: Current run pointer
description: site/current.json. The one file that moves when a run is published. A reader fetches it first, then reads every other file from the run it names, so it never sees a mix of two runs.

run.description: The run's name, which is its UTC start time followed by a random suffix. Names sort by age.

prefix.description: Where the run's files are, relative to the bucket root and ending in a slash. Append index.json, status.json, network.json or lines/<line>.json.

files.description: How many files the run holds.

previous.description: The runs that were current before this one, newest first. They stay in the bucket so a reader that fetched an older pointer can finish.
